Conduit of the Goddess|N/A|AoC}} }} |race= [[Sheikah]] |pronouns= he/him{{Cite|Before you could report your completion of the trial to Monk Maz Koshia, he rose before you and the final trial started.|Adventure Log|BotW}} |dungeon= [[Final Trial]] |habitat= |health=4000 |weakness= {{List| * [[Lightning]] * [[Mighty Bananas]] * [[Perfect Dodging]] }} |reward= [[Master Cycle Zero]] |exp= 100 |strategy= |voiceactor= [[Christian Rummel]] (English){{Cite Web|quote= /Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity by Nintendo/KOEI TECMO comes to Nintendo Switch, featuring Christian Rummel as Maz Koshia！|author= Christian Rummel|published= |retrieved= November 30, 2020|url= https://www.christianrummel.com/|title= Christian Rummel|site= official site|type= }} |theme= [[The Monk Maz Koshia]] }} '''Monk Maz Koshia''' is a recurring character and [[Boss]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Monk Maz Koshia||Series, BotW, AoC}} | {{List| * {{BotW}}{{Cite|'''Monk Maz Koshia'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} * {{AoC}}{{Cite|{{Color AoC|Blue|Monk Maz Koshia}}|N/A|AoC}} }} }} ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Monk Maz Koshia is a [[Sheikah]] [[Monk]] who is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack, appearing during the "[[EX The Champions' Ballad]] [[Main Quest]]. Monk Maz Koshia's goal is to test those who wish to undergo the [[Divine Beast Tamer's Trial]].{{Cite|I am Maz Koshia. I now address the one who wishes to master a Divine Beast...|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} He first speaks to [[Link]] inside the [[Shrine of Resurrection]], where he bestows the [[One-Hit Obliterator]] to him as the first part of his Trial.{{Cite|To undertake this task requires unwavering dedication. That weapon defeats foes with one hit. However, the reverse is also true, as its wielder will also fall to a single strike. You can use this weapon's ability only twice within a set period of time...only when it is glowing. When enough time passes, the weapon will regain its sheen along with its power.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} He informs Link that to complete this part of the Trial, he must travel to the four marked locations on the [[Great Plateau]] and defeat the bands of [[Monster]]s there.{{Cite|At the four marked locations within the Great Plateau...defeat all monsters present to prove your power. If you are not up to the challenge, leave this plateau. The weapon will return here, and the trial will end.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} After Link has done this, Monk Maz Koshia will congratulate Link on his progress and reveal that this task was the first of many in the Trial.{{Cite|I am Maz Koshia. You have done well to conquer the trials laid before you. You are Hyrule's beacon of hope. But your trails have only just begun. The divine weapon shall lead you...|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} The Monk continues, saying that the One-Hit Obliterator will guide him to the next steps. This causes the One-Hit Obliterato} to split into four glowing orbs, which scatter to various parts of [[Hyrule Kingdom]]. Monk Maz Koshia urges Link to follow them in order to continue.{{Cite|Now that you have proven your power, a new journey awaits. Go to the four locations that will be revealed to you, and reach for greater heights than ever before.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} After Link completes "[[EX Champion Daruk's Song]]", "[[EX Champion Mipha's Song]]", [[EX Champion Revali's Song]]", and "[[EX Champion Urbosa's Song]]", Monk Maz Koshia will call to Link once more, instructing him to return to the Shrine of Resurrection to face his final trial.{{Cite|I am Maz Koshia. I must commend you for conquering the trial thus far. The door to the final trial is now open at the Shrine of Resurrection. Go, and face your destiny.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Once Link returns to the Shrine of Resurrection, Monk Maz Koshia will greet him, instructing him to return the Sheikah Slate to the [[Sheikah Slate Pedestal]] he found it in to reveal the passageway to his [[Final Trial]].{{Cite|To the brave soul who wishes to master a Divine Beast... You have done well to return to this place of beginnings. You have overcome many challenges thus far. Now, allow me to bestow upon you one final trial. Return the Sheikah Slate to the terminal you first obtained it from. Do so, and the final passageway will reveal itself...|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Upon doing so, the door closest, and the chamber begins to descend.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Descending... Please beware of tremors.}}|Sheikah Slate Pedestal|BotW}} Once the chamber has fully descended, Monk Maz Koshia will welcome Link to the Final Trial, explaining that he can be found here.{{Cite|Welcome, hero. You have overcome many trials to reach me. Now it is time to face the final trial. This trial is a complex labyrinth.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} The Monk guides Link to the labyrinth's [[Guidance Stone]], after which he leaves Link to complete the labyrinth of his own accord.{{Cite|To start, you will need a map. You may obtain map information from the Guidance Stone.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Upon reaching the [[Monk's Pedestal]] bearing Monk Maz Koshia, he once again greets Link, revealing that there is one remaining part of the Final Trial.{{Cite|You have proven to possess the power of a true hero. In the name of the Goddess Hylia... I offer this final trial!|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Monk Maz Koshia stands up and [[Warping|Warps]] the two of them away to a platform in the sky, where they must do combat.{{Cite|Let us begin.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Once Link defeats Monk Maz Koshia, he will shrink to his normal size and commend Link for overcoming all of the obstacles he faced.{{Cite|You faced that challenge with great courage. You have erased all doubt from my mind. You are a true hero.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Afterwards, Monk Maz Koshia will activate the flying structure that they are on, causing the [[Master Cycle Zero]] to rise from within.{{Cite|As such, you were destined to take hold of this ancient masterpiece...|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Monk Maz Koshia explains that the Master Cycle Zero is a masterpiece of innovation that was intended for the "one true hero".{{Cite|That which you have obtained...is a masterpiece of innovation, created for the one true hero.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} With his role served, Monk Maz Koshia wishes Link well before returning him to the Great Plateau.{{Cite|Hero of Hyrule... May the Goddess smile upon you.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} After completing the battle, Link can talk to Monk Maz Koshia to battle him again as many times as he wants. On subsequent visits to his Monk's Pedestal, Maz Koshia commends Link for returning, but he claims that he has nothing left to give.{{Cite|I applaud you for having the fortitude to come here. I have nothing more to offer you.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Despite this, he reveals that the only thing he can do to help Link is challenge him to another battle.{{Cite|However, there is one thing I can do to help a hero such as yourself reach new heights... You may challenge me once more.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} After the fight, Monk Maz Koshia is assured that Link is capable of saving Hyrule.{{Cite|Most impressive. The fate of Hyrule is safe in your heroic hands.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} He tells Link to make use of the Master Cycle Zero and wishes him well.{{Cite|Now go, and make good use of the ancient masterpiece. May the Goddess smile upon the one true hero.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} Link will then be Warped back to the Shrine of Resurrection. ==Characteristics== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Monk Maz Koshia}} Monk Maz Koshia boasts a wide array of tactics that he may use in his fight against Link, many of which are similar to various other enemies. He wields unique versions of the [[Guardian Sword]] and [[Phrenic Bow]]. Like a [[Yiga Footsoldier]], Monk Maz Koshia can magically teleport and strike Link from above with his sword, or he may use his bow and shoot at Link from the air. Monk Maz Koshia can use [[Fire Arrow]]s, [[Ice Arrow]]s, and [[Shock Arrow]]s to strike Link. Eventually, he may begin rapidly dashing towards link in a similar manner as [[Thunderblight Ganon]], and uses the [[Earthwake Technique]] to create geysers that follow Link. These will damage Link if the eruption hits him directly, but they also provide [[Updraft]]s that can be used with the [[Paraglider]]. After Monk Maz Koshia's health has been reduced by 25%, he will retreat and split himself into nine copies. Each of these copies can damage Link, but the eight duplicates will disappear after one hit. In order to advance, Link must find the correct copy of Monk Maz Koshia and attack him. The copies will work in unison to attack Link, until they are destroyed. When all of the copies have been destroyed, Monk Maz Koshia may summon another set of them. If using the [[Camera]] [[Rune]], only the true version of Maz Koshia will be identified by it. Additionally, in [[Master Mode]], Monk Maz Koshia will not regenerate health during this phase. Once Monk Maz Koshia's health has been reduced to half, he will retreat again and magically enlarge himself while flying in the air. At this stage, Monk Maz Koshia can use charged laser attacks as are used by [[Guardian]]s to strike Link. If Link deflects one of these lasers back at Monk Maz Koshia, the Monk will be temporarily stunned, allowing Link to attack. Monk Maz Koshia may also summon a series of eight metallic [[Spiked Iron Ball]]s. Monk Maz Koshia will sequentially cast these at Link in an attempt to hurt him. Afterwards, Monk Maz Koshia will begin charging a [[Lightning]] storm, which will strike each of the balls. Much like with Thunderblight Ganon's metal spikes, Link can use Magnesis to direct one of the Spiked Iron Balls near Monk Maz Koshia, causing him to be struck and stunned by his own lightning. Monk Maz Koshia can also magically tilt the battle stage before summoning the Spiked Iron Balls, which will roll towards the bottom of the slope before falling off. With a quarter of his health remaining, Monk Maz Koshia will ground himself. If Link gets close to Monk Maz Koshia's feet, the Monk will stomp the ground, damaging the Hylian Champion. Monk Maz Koshia can also summon two miniature copies of himself, who will attack Link in a similar manner to the second phase of the fight. During the battle, Link can distract Monk Maz Koshia with [[Mighty Bananas]], leaving the Monk temporarily vulnerable to attack. If used during the phase where the monk has summoned copies, only the true one will be distracted. This can only be done once. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} Monk Maz Koshia is a [[Warrior]] in {{AoC}} that can be obtained as early as Chapter 4. After completing the "[[Destroy the Yiga Clan!]]" [[Scenario]], three [[Quest]]s will appear. These are "[[The Trial of Monsters]]", "[[The Trial of the Mighty Foe]]", and "[[The Trial of Stones]]". After completing all three, a new [[Challenge]] called "[[Trial of the Ancients]]" will appear, where the character will have to beat Monk Maz Koshia in three minutes. After this is completed, Monk Maz Koshia will become a playable Warrior. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== *Before using teleportation, Monk Maz Koshia summons a set of glyphs around him much like [[Yiga Footsoldier]]s do; however, they are written in the [[Sheikah (Language)|Sheikah script]] instead of the [[Hylian (Language)|Hylian script]] used by the Yiga. The glyphs in both cases read as "RPTSKJRZZ", the first letters of the Japanese names of the Buddhist version of the nine ''{{Wp|Kuji-in}}'' hand seals: ''Rin, Pyō, Tō, Sha, Kai, Jin, Retsu, Zai, Zen''. *If Link is defeated in battle with Monk Maz Koshia causing a [[Game Over]], continuing to attempt again will yield different dialogue acknowledging this.{{Cite|You have returned. Your heart is truly that of a hero.|Monk Maz Koshia|BotW}} This will also skip the cutscene where Maz Koshia stands up. ==Nomenclature== Like other Sheikah Monks, Maz Koshia's name is derived from the name of a developer at Nintendo: [[Yoshiaki Koizumi]]. {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Final Trial Boss Arena.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The arena where Link fights Monk Maz Koshia File:BotW Monk Maz Koshia Incantation Circles.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Monk Maz Koshia making copies of himself File:BotW Monk Maz Koshia Incantation Circle.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link fighting a giant Monk Maz Koshia File:AoC Monk Maz Koshia Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Monk Maz Koshia File:AoC Monk Maz Koshia Blurb.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}An in-game blurb about Monk Maz Koshia File:AoC Monk Maz Koshia Portrait Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Monk Maz Koshia's portrait File:AoC Monk Maz Koshia Portrait Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Monk Maz Koshia's portrait File:AoC Monk Maz Koshia Portrait Icon 3.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Monk Maz Koshia's portrait File:AoC Monk Maz Koshia Portrait Icon 4.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Monk Maz Koshia's portrait File:AoC Monk Maz Koshia Portrait Icon 5.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Monk Maz Koshia's portrait File:AoC Monk Maz Koshia Tapestry Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of Monk Maz Koshia ==See Also== {{See Also| * Final Trial * Monk * Sheikah }} {{Ref}} {{Bosses|BotW}} {{Categories |Beam Enemies, Hyruleans, Monks, Sheikah, Warriors |characters= BotW, AoC |bosses= BotW, AoC |playable= AoC }}
